socialPromo.subhead: My personal journey through parental criticism and the search for emotional safety.
socialPromo.scene: A young man, Farhan (18-20 years old, South Asian appearance), sits hunched over a desk in a dimly lit room, illuminated only by the faint glow of a laptop screen, which is currently off and placed just out of reach. His expression is thoughtful and slightly melancholic, reflecting a mix of frustration and quiet determination. In the background, a slightly open door reveals a brighter, active family living space, suggesting proximity but also distance. The composition emphasizes his isolation and the barrier between his internal world of ideas (represented by the laptop) and the external family environment.
